---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible Elysia problem without sharing private data
title: "[Bug] "
labels: bug
assignees: ""
---

## Affected release or development commit

State the Elysia version, install profile, and—when relevant—the development
commit. Do not paste local paths, credentials, private memory, or user data.

## Environment

Describe the operating system, installation type, and enabled profile or
optional component. Keep machine and account details to the minimum needed to
reproduce the problem.

## What happened

Describe the observed behavior and the expected behavior.

## Reproduction

List the smallest safe sequence that reproduces the problem. Use synthetic
files and redacted output. Do not attach secrets, private logs, proprietary
content, or another person's data.

## Bounded diagnostics

Include only sanitized Doctor output, receipt identifiers, or error text that
is safe to publish.

## Safety check

- [ ] This is not a vulnerability report. Security issues go to the private
      reporting path in `SECURITY.md`.
- [ ] I removed credentials, private memory, personal data, absolute local
      paths, and confidential content.
- [ ] I checked that the issue is not already reported.
